_comment: Shared golden vectors for the DoIP/UDS read-only codec. Both the Python reference (proto/bmwdiag) and the Swift package (ios-app/BMWLinkKit) assert against these so the two implementations stay byte-identical on the wire. All hex is lowercase, no separators. The VIN used here is synthetic test data, not a real vehicle.

vehicle_identification_request.note: version 02, inv fd, type 0001, len 0 (8-byte header, empty payload)

routing_activation_request_default.note: tester 0e00, activation type 00, reserved 4x00; payload=7 bytes

diagnostic_message_tester_present.note: src 0e00 -> target 0063, uds 3e00; frame = 8-byte header + payload
